summary: Layer 1B expansion for the transmission-line-hardware node found one high-relevance underfollowed pure-play candidate, two adjacent small/mid-cap second-order candidates, and one mega-cap reference anchor. The strongest direct fit is Preformed Line Products, whose products sit in electrical transmission/distribution line hardware and whose 2025 backlog growth provides a possible leading signal before utility/EPC revenue conversion. Valmont and AZZ are less pure but plausible adjacent beneficiaries through utility structures and corrosion-protection/metal-coatings exposure to transmission and distribution infrastructure. Quanta Services is included only as a reference/customer-demand anchor, not as the underfollowed discovery target.
